arxiv-2109-00072.title: QUASI-NEWTON METHODS FOR MINIMIZING A QUADRATIC FUNCTION SUBJECT TO UNCERTAINTY
arxiv-2109-00072.creator: Shen PENG, Gianpiero CANESSA, David EK, Anders FORSGREN
arxiv-2109-00072.description: Abstract We investigate quasi-Newton methods for minimizing a strictly convex quadratic function which is subject to errors in the evaluation of the gradients. The methods all give identical behavior in exact arithmetic, generating minimizers of Krylov subspaces of increasing dimensions, thereby having finite termination.

arxiv-2109-08366.title: Three-body and Coulomb interactions in a quasi-two-dimensional dipolar Bose condensed gas
arxiv-2109-08366.creator: S. Mostafa Moniri, Heshmatollah Yavari, Elnaz Darsheshdar
arxiv-2109-08366.description: Abstract In this paper, we studied a dilute quasi-two-dimensional dipolar Bose-condensed with two- and three-body contact, and Coulomb interactions using the Hartree-Fock-Bogoliubov-Popov approximation. We analyze numerically the effects of three-body contact, and Coulomb interactions on the energy spectrum, the quantum and thermal noncondensate fraction of the system.

arxiv-2112-02131.title: In-silico synthesis of lowest-pressure high- T c T_{\text{c}} ternary superhydrides
arxiv-2112-02131.creator: Roman Lucrezi, Simone Di Cataldo, Wolfgang von der Linden, Lilia Boeri, Christoph Heil
arxiv-2112-02131.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Roman Lucrezi, Simone Di Cataldo, Wolfgang von der Linden, Lilia Boeri, Christoph Heil. We report the theoretical prediction of two high-performing hydride superconductors BaSiH 8 and SrSiH 8 . They are thermodynamically stable above pressures of 130 and 174 GPa 174\text{\,}\mathrm{G}\mathrm{P}\mathrm{a} , respectively, and metastable below that.

arxiv-2208-05778.title: Collapsing scenario for the k -essence emergent generalised Vaidya spacetime in the context of massive gravity’s rainbow
arxiv-2208-05778.creator: Saibal Ray, Arijit Panda a, Bivash Majumder, Md. Rabiul Islam, Goutam Manna b
arxiv-2208-05778.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Saibal Ray, Arijit Panda a, Bivash Majumder, Md. Rabiul Islam, Goutam Manna b. In this paper, we study the collapsing scenario for the k- essence emergent Vaidya spacetime in the context of massive gravity’s rainbow. For this study, we consider that the background metric is Vaidya spacetime in massive gravity’s rainbow.

arxiv-2301-09622.title: Barrier-Based Test Synthesis for Safety-Critical Systems Subject to Timed Reach-Avoid Specifications
arxiv-2301-09622.creator: Prithvi Akella, Mohamadreza Ahmadi, Richard M. Murray, Aaron D. Ames
arxiv-2301-09622.description: Abstract We propose an adversarial, time-varying test-synthesis procedure for safety-critical systems without requiring specific knowledge of the underlying controller steering the system. arxiv-2405-05711.title: Zeta-functions of Curves over Finite Fields
arxiv-2405-05711.creator: Kin Wai (Edisy) Chan
arxiv-2405-05711.description: Abstract Curves over finite fields are of great importance in cryptography and coding theory. Through studying their zeta-functions, we would be able to find out vital arithmetic and geometric information about them and their Jacobians, including the number of rational points on this kind of curves.

arxiv-2412-00183.title: A non-perturbative construction of the de Sitter late-time boundary
arxiv-2412-00183.creator: Kamran Salehi Vaziri
arxiv-2412-00183.description: Abstract We propose a new approach for constructing the late-time conformal boundary of quantum field theory in de Sitter spacetime. A boundary theory which consists of a continuous family of primary operators residing on unitary irreducible representations, the principal series. These boundary operators exhibit two-point functions that include contact terms alongside standard CFT two-point functions.

arxiv-2501-01149.title: A3: Android Agent Arena for Mobile GUI Agents
arxiv-2501-01149.creator: Yuxiang Chai, Hanhao Li, Jiayu Zhang, Liang Liu, Guangyi Liu, Guozhi Wang, Shuai Ren, Siyuan Huang, Hongsheng Li
arxiv-2501-01149.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yuxiang Chai, Hanhao Li, Jiayu Zhang, Liang Liu, Guangyi Liu, Guozhi Wang, Shuai Ren, Siyuan Huang, Hongsheng Li. AI agents have become increasingly prevalent in recent years, driven by significant advancements in the field of large language models (LLMs). Mobile GUI agents, a subset of AI agents, are designed to autonomously perform tasks on mobile devices.

arxiv-2510-22467.title: Backward-Friendly Optimization: Training Large Language Models with Approximate Gradients under Memory Constraints
arxiv-2510-22467.creator: Anonymous Submission
arxiv-2510-22467.description: Abstract Full fine-tuning of Large Language Models (LLMs) is notoriously memory-intensive, primarily because conventional optimizers such as SGD or Adam assume access to exact gradients derived from cached activations. Existing solutions either alter the model architecture (e.g., reversible networks) or trade memory for computation (e.g., activation checkpointing), but the optimizer itself remains untouched.

arxiv-2511-01818.title: Skewness-dependent Moments of Pion GPD from Nonlocal Quark-Bilinear Correlators
arxiv-2511-01818.creator: Xiang Gao, Swagato Mukherjee, Qi Shi, Fei Yao, Yong Zhao
arxiv-2511-01818.description: Abstract We present lattice QCD calculations of the odd Mellin moments of pion valence-quark generalized parton distribution (GPD) up to fifth order, ⟨ x 4 ⟩ \langle x^{4}\rangle , and for the skewness range [ − 0.33 , 0 ] [-0.33,0] using operator product expansion of bilocal quark-bilinear operators.

arxiv-2512-08300.title: rSIM : Incentivizing Reasoning Capabilities of LLMs via Reinforced Strategy Injection
arxiv-2512-08300.creator: Sijia Chen, Baochun Li, Di Niu
arxiv-2512-08300.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) are post-trained through reinforcement learning (RL) to evolve into Reasoning Language Models (RLMs), where the hallmark of this advanced reasoning is “aha” moments when they start to perform strategies , such as self-reflection and deep thinking, within chain of thoughts (CoTs).

pmc-11460505.title: Amorphous zinc phosphate nanoclusters loaded polycarbonate thermosensitive hydrogel: An innovative strategy for promoting wound healing
pmc-11460505.creator: Siwen Chen, Yutong Li, Sihang Ren, Yuanyuan Yang, Zhipeng Hou, Siyu Han, Wanhong Zhang, Jing Guo, Jianshe Hu, Xing Zhang, Liqun Yang
pmc-11460505.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Skin trauma is a matter of great concern for public health, emphasizing the importance of reconstructing the microenvironment at the trauma site to facilitate tissue regeneration. Therefore, the investigation of innovative wound dressings has significant research and clinical implications. In this study, we prepared a thermosensitive hydrogel based on a hydrophilic-hydrophobic-hydrophilic triblock polycarbonate polymer (PTP), and created a composite hydrogel, PTPH-AZP, by incorporating amorphous zinc phosphate (AZP) nanoclusters.

pmc-11583695.title: Entrectinib-Induced Myocarditis and Acute Heart Failure Responding to Steroid Treatment: A Case Report
pmc-11583695.creator: Mehraab N Majeed, Subramanian Venkatesan, Dionysis Papadatos-Pastos, Tanya Ahmad, Martin Forster, Polyvios Demetriades, Daniel Johnathan Hughes, Sarah Benafif, Siow Ming Lee
pmc-11583695.description: A 72-year-old man presented to his general practitioner with worsening dyspnea and was diagnosed with having recurrent ROS1-positive stage IIIB NSCLC 8 years after initial diagnosis and radical treatment for early stage disease. He was subsequently started on entrectinib but required hospital admissions for recurrent acute kidney injuries on a background of chronic kidney disease.

pmc-11631004.description: Background:To reveal the clinical value of cuproptosis-related genes on prognosis and metastasis in non-small cell lung cancer.Methods:Gene expression profiles and clinical information of non-small cell lung cancer were downloaded from The Cancer Genome Atlas and Gene Expression Omnibus databases. The data were grouped into training set, internal testing set, and external testing set.
